title: Prompt-set registry + golden dataset versioning to detect eval regressions on config/model changes
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Model/config rollouts sometimes cause subtle QA regressions that are not caught by coarse smoke tests. We need a first-class system to manage curated prompt sets (aka prompt registry) and golden datasets with stable metadata, access controls, and immutable versions so eval pipelines can run deterministic regressions on every config change and model variant.

Scope: Build a prompt-set registry service + golden dataset store and integrate with existing eval runner so that: (1) PRs that touch runtime, routing, or model config automatically trigger the relevant prompt-set suites; (2) eval results are associated with exact prompt-set and dataset version; (3) product and SRE can audit which prompt-set was used for a given regression; (4) fine-grained permissions let PMs curate golden sets while blocking free-form edits; (5) provide simple migration/rollback primitives for prompt-set changes.

High-level approach:
- Define a minimal registry schema (PromptSet ID, version tag, author, description, labels, dataset pointer, fingerprint, created_at, immutable snapshot link).
- Use content-addressed storage for golden dataset snapshots (S3 + sha256 index) and keep metadata in our metadata DB.
- Add APIs for: create-promptset, snapshot-promptset, list-promptsets, get-promptset-version, deprecate-version.
- Integrate the registry into CI: a GH action that, on changes to runtime/config or on model rollouts, queries which prompt-sets are impacted via labels and starts eval jobs.
- Build UI hooks in Console (a follow-up PM ticket) to browse/copy prompt-sets and request permissions.

Non-goals: Design Console UX, implement RBAC audit UI, or rework eval metrics; those are separate tickets.
acceptance_criteria: PromptSet registry accepts creation and snapshotting of prompt-sets and returns immutable version IDs (sha256-like).
Eval runner can be pointed to a specific PromptSet version and produces repeatable results for the same model/config pair.
Metadata records store author, change reason, labels, and pointer to snapshot; snapshots are content-addressed and immutable.
GH action integration triggers relevant prompt-set eval suites on: runtime config PRs, model pin changes, and releases to dedicated capacity.
PMs can mark a prompt-set version as golden; regressions against golden sets generate an alert webhook to the quality channel with diff summary and link to artifacts.
Documented rollout/rollback flow for prompt-set changes in Confluence with example CLI commands.
Unit and integration tests covering API, snapshot integrity, and eval invocation path.

activity: 2026-02-19: Kickoff meeting with PM (R. Mendes), Design (L. Park) and SRE. Decided to keep snapshots immutable and content-addressed to avoid accidental drift.
2026-02-23: Schema draft posted to Confluence (link below). Jonah proposed 'fingerprint' as sha256 of canonicalized JSON; PM asked to include human-readable version tags.
2026-03-01: Backend prototype created: POST /promptsets creates meta record. Snapshot flow still WIP. Linked PR: github.com/redwood-inference/prompt-registry/pull/37
2026-03-05: Security reviewed data retention policy; decided golden snapshots retained for 5 years. No secret data allowed in prompt-set snapshots (enforce via CI lint).
2026-03-10: Eval-runner integration spike completed. Eval jobs accept 'promptset_version' and results include 'promptset_id' and 'promptset_version'. Added tests for deterministic replay.
